jobs.name: PatrolIdleV1
jobs.label: 순찰대원
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE game-ready static idle enemy sprite, pixel art, transparent PNG, for the MiniWar 2D side-scrolling action RPG.
Input image 1 is a DESIGN REFERENCE only: the masked human bandit from the user's Elsword Elder screenshot. Keep the anonymous human silhouette, a cloth hood and a real copper/wooden face mask with dark eye holes. Image 2 is a STYLE / SCALE reference only: the approved MiniWar heroes. Match its deliberate pixel clusters and grounded side-view proportions, not the heroes' costumes.
Draw only ONE fully connected adult humanoid, full body including complete head, hands, weapon and both boots. Three-quarter SIDE view facing RIGHT. STATIC relaxed combat-ready standing idle, weight planted on both feet, knees very slightly bent; no attack, running, walking, motion streaks or animation sequence. Medium sturdy human build about 6 heads tall, slimmer than a brute, slightly shorter than the heroes. Normal-length attached arms, natural forearm thickness, full-length legs, no chibi, no oversized head.
The shared faction design: invading medieval dark-magic kingdom's masked soldiers; charcoal hood / cowl, dark brown leather, worn gray metal, desaturated burgundy cloth accents. Face fully hidden by a visibly separate angular aged copper mask; two black eye slits, no visible face, no skull face, no gas-mask hoses.
PIXEL MEDIUM essential: actual hand-clustered pixel-art look, apparent native character height about 180-210 pixels shown at clean integer enlargement. Sharp square pixels, dark 1-2 logical-pixel outline, deliberate stair-step diagonals, 3-5 colors per material, readable large shadow shapes and restrained highlights. Match the second reference's classic Korean action-RPG sprite craft. No smooth illustration, airbrush, blur, 3D render, photographic texture, gradient glow, noisy stippling or nearest-neighbor filtered painting.
Canvas: square 1024x1024, single centered character fills roughly 82% of height with safe padding. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with real alpha, no backdrop, no floor, no shadow, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no labels, no UI, no typography, no watermark. Everything outside the sprite fully transparent. Feet share one horizontal baseline. Normalized lighting from upper-left.
Specific enemy variant:
Masked patrol infantry. Short charcoal hood, aged bronze face mask, dark brown leather brigandine vest over a black short-sleeved tunic, small burgundy waist sash, fitted dark trousers and simple leather boots. A short plain steel sword held low diagonally ahead of the body in the RIGHT hand, free hand near the belt; no shield. Readable basic melee soldier silhouette, balanced regular build, alert quiet idle. Blade remains inside canvas. Mask and cloth clearly distinguishable.
